description: The bar chart titled "Runtime Comparison of Models in Streaming Environment" compares the runtime in seconds of different models within a streaming environment. The vertical axis, labeled "Runtime (seconds)," is linear and shows the runtime values for each model. The horizontal axis lists the names of the models: "Our Joint Framework," "ChatGPT," "DeepSeek," "LLaMA," and "Claude." The chart uses two colors to differentiate the models: dark green for "Our Joint Framework" and sky blue for "LLM Models." The runtime values are annotated above each bar, with "Our Joint Framework" having a runtime of 77 seconds, "ChatGPT" at 190 seconds, "DeepSeek" at 365 seconds, "LLaMA" at 172 seconds, and "Claude" at 250 seconds. The bars are not sorted in any specific order, and no bars are visually emphasized. The chart includes a legend in the upper left corner, identifying the color coding for the two types of models. The figure is saved as "8-62116.jpg" in JPEG format with a resolution of 300 dots per inch (dpi).
